text:
You need small but important WordPress edits on an existing travel site, plus a simple informational solar site with a blog and Facebook integration that can support lead generation.

I’m Tobias Reyne, with 7 years of experience building full stack web work across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML and CSS.

Recent relevant work:
- Multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics: built a 4-language docs site in MDX with instant search; support tickets dropped 27%.
- Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home: replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront; largest contentful paint improved from 4.1s to 1.3s and organic traffic rose 38%.

I’m comfortable with organized content changes, blog setup, and ongoing maintenance, and I’m available for phone/Teams/Zoom meetings.
